provenance: OpenSpiel 2.0.2 (Lanctot et al. 2019), game leduc_poker with default parameters (players=2, starting_player=0, suit_isomorphism=False), independent run on 2026-09-13: 936 information states, 5520 terminal histories, max utility 13; CFR+ average-policy value for seat 0 -0.08559349 after 1000 iterations and -0.08560604 after 5000 iterations with exploitability 1.8385e-05 (NashConv/2).
Script truth/derivations/openspiel_leduc.py, output truth/derivations/openspiel_leduc.out; reproduction command in truth/README.md.

rules.deck: 6 cards = 3 ranks (J, Q, K) x 2 suits (s, h); card index = rank*2 + suit (Js=0, Jh=1, Qs=2, Qh=3, Ks=4, Kh=5)
rules.order: seat 0 acts first in both rounds
rules.raise_cap: at most two raises per round, with the opening bet counting toward the cap
rules.board: one public card dealt before round 2
rules.showdown: a pair with the board beats a high card, otherwise the higher rank wins; equal ranks split the pot
